================================================================================
                           ANCIENT SCROLL OF SIGHT
================================================================================

It is pitch black in these catacombs.
You have magickal spells that reveal the world around you.

================================================================================
                      BASIC MOVEMENT INCANTATIONS
================================================================================

COMMAND            PURPOSE                      DESCRIPTION
--------           --------                     -----------
ls                 See room contents            List all items in current room
cd directory       Move to a room               Enter a directory (room)
cd ..              Go back                      Return to the previous room
pwd                Where am I?                  Print your current location

================================================================================
                         MAGICKAL VIEWING SPELLS
================================================================================

COMMAND            PURPOSE                      DESCRIPTION
--------           --------                     -----------
cat filename       View scrolls fully           Display entire scroll content
less filename      Read long scrolls            Page through text (q to quit)
head filename      Peek at scroll start         See first 10 lines only
tail filename      Check scroll ending          See last 10 lines only
wc filename        Count scroll contents        Count lines, words, characters

Try looking around this room, then move into one of the next rooms.

================================================================================
                          EXAMPLE INCANTATIONS
================================================================================

    $ pwd                    # Where am I?
    $ ls                     # What is in this room?
    $ cat scroll             # Read a scroll (you are doing this now!)
    $ less scroll            # Page through a long scroll (press q to quit)
    $ head scroll            # See just the beginning
    $ tail scroll            # See just the ending
    $ wc scroll              # How long is this scroll?
    $ cd cellar              # Move into the cellar
    $ cd ..                  # Come back to where you were

Remember to cast these spells when you discover new scrolls and treasures!

================================================================================
                           THE FIRST CHALLENGE
================================================================================

Before you venture deeper into the catacombs, you must prove your mastery
of the viewing spells. Practice reading this very scroll with different
commands to understand their power.

SIDE PATH -- BUILD YOUR OWN WORKSHOP:
The workshop does not exist yet -- a true mage does not merely explore
rooms, they CONJURE them. Build your first room with your bare hands:

    mkdir workshop           # Conjure a new room from the void
    cd workshop              # Step inside the room you just made
    pwd                      # Confirm the room is real
    touch hammer             # Forge your first artifact
    ls                       # Behold your creation
    cd ..                    # Return here to the entrance

You have just bent the dungeon to your will. mkdir, touch, ls, and cd
are the foundation of all creation magick.

NEXT DESTINATION:
When you are ready, seek the CELLAR -- a chamber that lies beneath this
entrance. The cellar holds ancient secrets about seeing through illusions
and distinguishing between doorways and objects.

    cd cellar

LOST? Remember these two spells:
    pwd                      Shows exactly where you are
    cd ..                    Takes you back one room

May your terminal skills grow strong, brave adventurer!

================================================================================
🔥 Achievement unlocked: Seasoned Adventurer — Earned 150 XP.  (+5 XP)
★  You are now Archmage of the Command Line!

################################################################################
#                🌟 THE CELLAR OF TRUE SIGHT - ENHANCED TERMINAL VISION       #
################################################################################

🔮 ANCIENT WISDOM: Seeing Beyond the Veil
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

*The air grows thick with mystical energy as you descend into the cellar...*
*Here, ancient magic teaches adventurers to distinguish reality from illusion.*

**Illusions are strong here.** It is difficult to tell what is a doorway and what is an object.
The untrained eye sees only a simple list of names, but the wise terminal mage learns to
perceive the **true nature** of all things in the catacombs.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
⚡ THE ENHANCED SIGHT SPELL: ls -F
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The magic spell you use to look can be **augmented** with powerful enchantments.

*Master this incantation to pierce through the veils of confusion...*

┌─ ENHANCED SIGHT INCANTATION ───────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                                                             │
│ $ ls -F                           # Cast enhanced sight spell              │
│                                                                             │
│ Expected Manifestation:                                                     │
│ scroll  treasure*  armoury/  README.md                                     │
│                                                                             │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
🎯 What the Mystical Symbols Reveal
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

When you cast `ls -F`, the mystical energies reveal secrets through their symbols:

┌─────────────────┬────────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────┐
│ SYMBOL          │ TYPE                       │ DESCRIPTION                  │
├─────────────────┼────────────────────────────┼──────────────────────────────┤
│ /               │ Directory (Chamber)        │ Rooms you can enter          │
│ *               │ Executable (Encounter)     │ Interactive adventures       │
│ @               │ Symbolic Link (Portal)     │ Magickal doorways            │
│ |               │ Named Pipe (Channel)       │ Communication pathways       │
│ =               │ Socket (Connection)        │ Network junction points      │
│ (none)          │ Regular File (Scroll)      │ Documents and knowledge      │
└─────────────────┴────────────────────────────┴──────────────────────────────┘

################################################################################
#              🪄 THE ALIAS ENCHANTMENT: Permanent Spell Enhancement          #
################################################################################

You can avoid having to type `ls -F` every time by weaving a **command alias** -
a permanent enchantment that enhances your basic spells:

╭─ PERMANENT ENHANCEMENT SPELL ──────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│                                                                             │
│ $ alias ls='ls -F'                # Weave the permanent enchantment        │
│                                                                             │
│ Effect: Your basic 'ls' spell now carries enhanced sight                   │
│                                                                             │
╰─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
🎓 Understanding Shell Aliases
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

This is known as a **shell alias** or **command alias**. With this alias active:

• Typing simply `ls` by itself will automatically run `ls -F`
• Your spell becomes permanently enhanced for this terminal session  
• The magic persists until you close your terminal or create a new alias

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
🔄 Try It Out! - Interactive Learning Path
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

PRACTICE PATH: Discovery → Understanding → Mastery

    1. FIRST STEP: Cast the enhanced spell manually
       $ ls -F

    2. SECOND STEP: Create the permanent enchantment  
       $ alias ls='ls -F'

    3. THIRD STEP: Test your enhanced spell
       $ ls

    4. FOURTH STEP: Verify the magic worked
       $ alias ls
       (This reveals your current alias definition)

################################################################################
#                  🏆 ADVANCED SIGHT TECHNIQUES: Master's Methods             #
################################################################################

⚡ COLOR-ENHANCED VISION: Advanced Sight Magic
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

For terminals that support color magic, enhance your sight even further:

╭─ CHROMATIC ENHANCEMENT SPELL ──────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│                                                                             │
│ $ alias ls='ls -F --color=auto'   # Weave color into your sight            │
│                                                                             │
│ Color Manifestations:                                                       │
│ • Blue: Directories (chambers)                                             │
│ • Green: Executables (encounters)                                          │
│ • Cyan: Symbolic links (portals)                                           │
│ • White: Regular files (scrolls)                                           │
│                                                                             │
╰─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

⚡ DETAILED INSPECTION: The Master's Eye
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

When you need to examine items more thoroughly:

╭─ COMPREHENSIVE SIGHT SPELL ────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│                                                                             │
│ $ ls -laF                         # Master-level inspection spell          │
│                                                                             │
│ This reveals hidden knowledge:                                              │
│ • -l: Long format (permissions, size, modification time)                   │
│ • -a: Hidden files (starting with '.')                                     │
│ • -F: Your familiar file type indicators                                   │
│                                                                             │
╰─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

################################################################################
#          🎯 CELLAR CHALLENGE: Master the Enhanced Sight Spells              #
################################################################################

Before you may claim the **emerald amulet** that awaits in this chamber,
prove your mastery of the ancient sight arts:

REQUIRED TASKS:
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
✅ Cast Enhanced Sight: Use ls -F to see the true nature of this cellar
✅ Create Permanent Enhancement: Set up the alias ls='ls -F' enchantment  
✅ Test Your Magic: Verify that plain ls now shows file type indicators
✅ Explore Thoroughly: Use enhanced sight to identify all chambers and encounters
✅ Find the Treasure: Locate and examine the treasure file in this room

EXPECTED DISCOVERIES:
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
In this cellar, your enhanced sight should reveal:

┌─ CHAMBER CONTENTS ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                                                             │
│ 🏰 Directories ending with / (chambers you can enter)                      │
│ 🗡️ Executables ending with * (encounters you can experience)               │
│ 📜 Regular files with no suffix (scrolls to read)                          │
│                                                                             │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

################################################################################
#               💡 PATH TO MASTERY: Building Terminal Intuition               #
################################################################################

🧠 WHY THIS KNOWLEDGE MATTERS:
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

Understanding file types is **fundamental** to terminal mastery:

• **Safety**: Know if something is executable before running it
• **Navigation**: Quickly identify which items are directories
• **Efficiency**: Understand your environment at a glance
• **Problem-solving**: Debug issues by understanding file types

🚀 REAL-WORLD APPLICATIONS:
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

╭─ PROFESSIONAL CONTEXTS ────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│                                                                             │
│ • System Administration: Quickly assess directory contents                 │
│ • Development: Identify scripts, configs, and executables                  │
│ • Debugging: Understand file permissions and types                         │
│ • Automation: Write scripts that handle different file types               │
│                                                                             │
╰─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

💰 TREASURE VAULT: The Emerald Amulet Awaits
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

Once you've mastered the enhanced sight spell and understand the true nature
of files in the terminal realm, seek out the **treasure** in this chamber.

The emerald amulet you'll find here is more than decoration - it unlocks
**new pathways** deeper into the catacombs, revealing hidden chambers that
were previously concealed from untrained eyes.
